column1: # One row per kernel. Columns are TAB-separated:
#   category    path(relative to repo root)    size    slow_path_tag
# `size` is passed to the program after `--` (an Int loop bound, a fib arg, or a
# fixture path for the selfhost cases). Lines starting with `#` are ignored.
# Coverage goal: every major slow path (anything the native Cranelift tier does
# NOT cover) has at least one focused kernel here. Int-arith/control kernels are
# kept as the fast-path baseline to measure the others against.
# --- JIT hot path: native-ELIGIBLE kernels (native actually compiles + runs).
# These are the only kernels where nat/reg should drop well below 1.0; they are
# the regression anchors for the native tier itself.
profile-closure-pic benchmarks/vm-jit/kernels/profile_closure_pic.rss            600000    profile-guided polymorphic closure inline cache
profile-branch-side-exit benchmarks/vm-jit/kernels/profile_branch_side_exits.rss  1         profile-guided whole-function branch side exits
native-call-nested  benchmarks/vm-jit/kernels/native_call_nested_chain.rss       250000    nested native cross-function call chain
native-call-bool    benchmarks/vm-jit/kernels/native_call_bool_param.rss         750000    native cross-function call with Bool param/return
native-call-float   benchmarks/vm-jit/kernels/native_call_float_param.rss        750000    native cross-function call with Float param/return
native-call-flat-int benchmarks/vm-jit/kernels/native_call_flat_int_param.rss     750000    native cross-function call with flat List<Int> param
native-call-flat-float benchmarks/vm-jit/kernels/native_call_flat_float_param.rss 750000    native cross-function call with flat List<Float> param
native-call-flat-int-mut benchmarks/vm-jit/kernels/native_call_flat_int_mut_param.rss 500000 native cross-function call with mutable flat List<Int> param
native-call-handle  benchmarks/vm-jit/kernels/native_call_handle_param.rss       250000    native cross-function call with Handle param
native-call-mut-handle benchmarks/vm-jit/kernels/native_call_mut_handle_param.rss 250000    native cross-function call with mutable Handle param
native-map-get      benchmarks/vm-jit/kernels/native_map_get_match_loop.rss       200000    fused Map.get match helper loop
# --- VM slow paths (native bails or is not eligible).
struct-nested       benchmarks/vm-jit/kernels/nested_struct_field.rss            300000    nested struct build + a.b.c reads
closure-dynamic     benchmarks/vm-jit/kernels/dynamic_closure_call.rss           200000    stored owned Fn dynamic call
json-field          benchmarks/vm-jit/kernels/json_field_access_only.rss         500000    diagnostic: Json.field_int on parsed object
mailbox-ring        benchmarks/vm-jit/kernels/mailbox_ring_only.rss              60000     diagnostic: mailbox O(1) send/take ring
# --- OSR (on-stack replacement) kernels: hot loop in an I/O-tangled (native-INELIGIBLE)
# function; jit-native auto-OSRs. The whole function never reaches the native tier (the
# Log.write calls keep it off the whole-function native subset), so ONLY OSR can run the
# loop natively. `size` is the loop bound (consumed via bench_size), chosen so the reg_vm
# median lands in the hundreds-of-ms range, comparable to the other kernels above.
osr-scalar              benchmarks/vm-jit/kernels/osr_scalar_loop.rss                3000000   OSR pure-Int scalar hot loop in I/O-tangled fn
osr-option              benchmarks/vm-jit/kernels/osr_option_loop.rss                2000000   OSR × J3: non-escaping Option<Int> per iter
osr-variant             benchmarks/vm-jit/kernels/osr_variant_loop.rss               1400000   OSR × J3: non-escaping user variant per iter
osr-struct              benchmarks/vm-jit/kernels/osr_struct_loop.rss                2400000   OSR × J3: non-escaping flat struct per iter
osr-closure             benchmarks/vm-jit/kernels/osr_closure_loop.rss               2700000   OSR × J2: inline capturing Int closure in loop
osr-multifield-variant  benchmarks/vm-jit/kernels/osr_multifield_variant_loop.rss    1150000   OSR × J3: multi-field variant arms per iter
osr-float-closure       benchmarks/vm-jit/kernels/osr_float_closure_loop.rss         2400000   OSR × J2: inline capturing Float closure in loop
